description: NEW IN THIS REVIEW. pt-PT as a donor for requesters outside its own language -- the last unexercised role in the clause's seven-locale list. pt-PT's cardinal rule set is one:'i = 1 and v = 0' (identical to English), many:'e = 0 and i != 0 and i%1000000 = 0 and v = 0 or e != 0..5', other:everything else. So it is discriminated from en only at a millions count, and from fr/ru/ar at 0. Only pt-PT is loaded for the 'pt' language code, so DefaultStrings installs it as its own identity tiebreaker and no explicit tiebreakers entry is required; five loaded locales, five distinct primary language codes.
